SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, SUM(closing_value) AS total_value
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units)) distinct_vals,
         MIN(closing_units) mn_u, MAX(closing_units) mx_u
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) dup_keys, SUM(n) rows_in_dups, SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_vals=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical_dups, SUM(CASE WHEN loads=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) two_loads, MAX(n) max_n, SUM(CASE WHEN mn_u<>mx_u THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unit_diff
FROM d

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date
),
stock_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units
    FROM fact_stock_week
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM stock_dedup fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS weeks, MIN(n_rows) AS min_rows, MAX(n_rows) AS max_rows, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_value
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fs.*
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
)
SELECT x.week_ending_date,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_store,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_product,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.region='West' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pseudo_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.closing_value IS NULL OR x.closing_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.region='West' AND ABS(x.closing_value - x.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_value_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.region='West' AND x.closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS west_zero_units
FROM x LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=x.product_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM stock_dedup fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
